[FACT] User has a Labrador named Max.  
[EVENT] User is thinking of enrolling Max in obedience training classes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Obedience training is fantastic for Labradors.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Most obedience training schools require proof of up-to-date vaccinations for dogs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Common vaccinations typically required include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Rabies: Proof of vaccination is often mandatory.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Distemper, Hepatitis, Parvovirus (DHPP): These are core vaccinations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Bordetella (kennel cough): Often required to prevent the spread of kennel cough.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should check with the training school for specific vaccination requirements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should provide a copy of Max's vaccination records and a health certificate from the veterinarian if required.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should consult with their veterinarian to ensure Max is up-to-date on vaccinations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Good luck with Max's obedience training!  
[USER] User needs to get Max's vaccination records in order.
